meta.author: Rabindranath Tagore
meta.title: Tagore source-corpus dictionary lookup coverage
meta.sourceCoverageScope: All 3,438 records in RabindraNet's version-2 Bengali NLTR-derived corpus across poetry, song groups, novels, stories, plays, essays and miscellany. Supplemented with 59 revision-pinned published literary letters from Bengali Wikisource.
meta.normalization: Unicode NFC; zero-width characters and BOM removed; repeated whitespace collapsed; duplicate normalized forms grouped.
meta.exactMethod: At least one exact indexed Bangla dictionary headword exists.
meta.inferredMethod: No exact headword; a labelled related base form or modern spelling has an exact dictionary match after resolver validation.
meta.denominator: All normalized surface forms and their occurrence counts in the supplied corpus; unresolved forms remain in both denominators.
limitations: A source corpus inventory is not proof that every work, manuscript version, private letter or rare word by Tagore is covered.
The research bulk corpus is a 2022 snapshot; additions and corrections to its original NLTR source after that date are not implied.
Records include introductory pieces and dedications; song records may contain groups of songs, so record count is not a count of distinct literary works.
NLTR's introduction says further letters and original English writings are planned; this Bengali inventory does not cover every private letter or English original.
Surface forms include inflections, archaic spellings, Brajabuli, proper names and possible transcription errors; occurrence in literature is not a verified dictionary meaning.
Per-item NLTR node URLs were not retained by the bulk dataset; its items link to the dataset and retain collection title and exact CSV row instead.
Only word counts and source references are distributed; original digitized literary texts remain in the external local cache.
This audit measures dictionary lookups for the supplied source inventory; it does not verify completeness of Tagore’s entire bibliography.
An exact match means a dictionary headword exists, not that every literary sense or contextual meaning has been verified.
Inferred matches expose a related dictionary base form or modern spelling; they are not exact definitions of the literary surface form.
Unresolved words can include inflections, historical spellings, Brajabuli, names, compounds and transcription errors; corpus occurrence alone supplies no verified meaning.
Source records can group songs or represent introductory pieces; record counts are not counts of distinct literary works.
